{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I'll bet you ten credits Ackbar City doesn’t even have an orchestra.''"<br />"''You’re on.''"<br />"''An orchestra of living musicians. Not a droid orchestra.|Voort saBinring to Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
An '''orchestra''' was a group of [[Music/Legends|musicians]] that played musical instruments collaboratively. The [[Imperial Symphony Orchestra]] was a well known example.

The [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] maintained an orchestra on board, who played smoothing subharmonic [[Music/Legends|music]] in the [[Grand Ballroom (Kuari Princess)|Grand Ballroom]] while passengers danced at night.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
